findings: Catalog contains both standard forms and explicitly voluntary forms. Voluntary labels are retained per source row; an unlabeled row is not automatically declared mandatory.

The mandatory-forms FAQ states standard court forms cannot be modified and users may attach additional information. Its format FAQ describes PDF viewing/printing and Word downloading/completion. These statements are retained without construing a blanket reuse grant.
All acquired filing-form originals contain a no-modification notice. Originals, fields, security settings, and content are unchanged. Procedural guides are classified separately.
The legal disclaimer describes public-service information that may change and disclaims accuracy and legal-advice status; it is not treated as affirmative republication permission.

Revision dates concern substantive form changes. Source-listed dates and printed month/year markers are separate observations; SC-5130V differs. HTTP Last-Modified and site footer update dates are not used as publication dates.
